trigger: Resting order at 204 in the 203-205 breakout-retest zone; conditional strength entry if no pullback comes; accelerate tranche two on a confirmed close above 216; later adds near 194-196 or a reassessed flush toward 183.

reevaluation: Close above 216 accelerates the build; monitor the next two earnings prints for continued operating-margin compression; reassess before deploying into a flush toward 183.

reevaluation: Q3 filing and print: margin recovery, positive operating cash flow, stabilized cash burn, or confirmed liquidity deterioration determine the active branch.

ambiguity: The post-print branches are not fully executable: 'first pullback' has no stated entry price, and 'defined-risk downside expression' does not specify instrument, entry, stop, or cover objective.

reevaluation: Verify the late-November Q3 date before tranches two and three; reassess after the print for durable ~20% margins versus normalization.

Orders are weighted toward 153-158 over 145-150 in one plan, while another assigns fixed ~30% tranches to each zone; tranches two and three are also gated on verifying the Q3 date.
The position is capped near $30,000 but must be cut to no more than ~$10,000 through Q3, while another instruction says trim to roughly half size if it runs above ~170.
The late-November Q3 report date must be verified before tranches two and three activate.
The binary Q3 print either confirms durable ~20% margins and permits completing the allocation or validates margin normalization and requires exit.
